newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady but downtrend intact.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady but downtrend intact.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were little changed, but are likely to move lower late Wednesday amid increased supplies and softening cargo prices, traders said.

A shipowner was heard to have purchased a cargo of 380 cst at $115. Most majors were quoting around $117, traders said. Bunker 380 cst prices were quoted between $111-$113 on Tuesday. Bunker 180 cst was quoted between $121-$123 against Tuesday's $117-$120. While prices are quoted higher, traders expected levels to ease later Wednesday as more sellers emerged.
MDO was quoted at $205-$210 and gas oil at $220-$225. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082)
